evidence.summary: CASI describes the Army Institute of NBC Defence (陆军防化学院) in Beijing’s Changping District as the PLA Army’s school for nuclear, biological and chemical defence. Founded in 1950 as the PLA’s first chemical defence school, it trains NBC command and engineering officers and NCOs, supports chemical weapons compliance work and nuclear emergency response, and its laboratories include one recorded with the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons for synthesising Schedule 1 chemicals and others for nuclear radiation and nuclear explosion monitoring.
The institute reports to PLA Army headquarters; it was under the General Staff Department from 1986 until the 2015 reforms.
